question_text: She asked me ______ that way led to the rail station.
explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No chuyển sang gián tiếp dùng "whether/if": She asked me whether that way led to the station.

question_text:
Lan is asking her mother for permission.
Lan: "Can I watch a horror film, Mum?"
Mom: "______"
opt_d: No, dear, you can't. It's late.
explanation: Từ chối lời xin phép một cách tự nhiên và có lý do: "No, dear, you can't. It's late." A cũng là lời từ chối nhưng cụt lủn, thiếu lý do; B, C đúng ngữ pháp nhưng không phải câu đáp lại lời xin phép.

question_text:
Mai is talking to the owner of a homestay.
Mai: "Would you mind if I took some photos of your garden for my travel blog?"
Owner: "______"
explanation: "Would you mind if...?" muốn đồng ý thì trả lời phủ định: "Not at all / No, go ahead." "Yes" nghĩa là phiền.

question_text: We joined a tour group ______ members came from various countries around the world.
explanation: "members" thuộc về "a tour group" → dùng đại từ sở hữu quan hệ "whose" + danh từ.

question_text: My uncle works as ______ engineer at a resort in Phu Quoc.
explanation: Danh từ đếm được số ít chỉ nghề nghiệp sau "work as" cần mạo từ không xác định; "engineer" bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm /e/ nên dùng "an".

question_text: On the way to the reef, the guide stopped ______ us some safety rules before we went snorkeling.
explanation: "stop to V" = dừng việc đang làm để làm việc khác (dừng lại để dặn dò); "stop V-ing" = thôi không làm nữa.

question_text: If I ______ more free time, I would travel around Viet Nam by motorbike.
explanation: Mệnh đề chính "I would travel" → câu điều kiện loại 2 (giả định ở hiện tại): If + quá khứ đơn → "had".

question_text: He looked so funny, so we couldn't help ______ at him.
explanation: "can't/couldn't help + V-ing" = không nhịn được làm gì.

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (14).
explanation: "in the summer months" — dùng "in" với mùa, tháng.

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (15).

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (16).
explanation: Sau tính từ "extraordinary" và trước "that" cần danh từ: "beauty".

question_text: Put the sentences (a–c) in the correct order to make a logical text.

question_text: Choose the sentence that can end the text (in Question 17) most appropriately.
opt_a: Finally, we managed to reach our destination, but it was already dark.
opt_b: We quickly found a mechanic, and the car was fixed in no time.
opt_c: The car broke down, so we had to return home without enjoying the weekend.
opt_d: The countryside was beautiful, and we had a great time exploring it.
explanation: Câu kết phải nối tiếp việc được giúp sửa xe và khớp ý "mọi việc không suôn sẻ": cuối cùng đến nơi nhưng trời đã tối.

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (19).
explanation: "for + khoảng thời gian" (for centuries) đi với thì hiện tại hoàn thành; "since" đi với mốc thời gian; "ago" đi với quá khứ đơn và đứng sau khoảng thời gian.

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (20).
explanation: "doubt if/whether + mệnh đề" = nghi ngờ liệu... có... hay không.

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (22).
explanation: "structures" là vật, làm tân ngữ của "can see" → đại từ quan hệ "which".

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (23).

question_text: Choose the option that best fits the numbered blank (24).
explanation: "narrow down" = thu hẹp dần lựa chọn (200 → 70 → 21 → 7).

question_text: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original sentence: Sarah wondered, "Can we swim in the Dead Sea?"
opt_a: Sarah asked if they could swim in the Dead Sea.
opt_b: Sarah thought swimming wasn't allowed in the Dead Sea.
opt_c: Sarah asked if the Dead Sea was a good place for swimming.
opt_d: Sarah wondered whether they can swim in the Dead Sea.
explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No gián tiếp: if/whether + S + V lùi thì (can → could), "we" → "they". D không lùi thì.

question_text: Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the original sentence: Unless you book the tour early, you won't get a cheap ticket.
opt_a: If you book the tour early, you won't get a cheap ticket.
opt_b: If you don't book the tour early, you won't get a cheap ticket.
opt_c: If you didn't book the tour early, you wouldn't get a cheap ticket.
opt_d: Unless you don't book the tour early, you will get a cheap ticket.
explanation: "Unless" = "If ... not": Unless you book early → If you don't book early; giữ nguyên thì của câu điều kiện loại 1. C đổi sang loại 2 nên sai nghĩa; D phủ định hai lần.

question_text: Choose the sentence that is made from the given cues: tour / include / a visit / a nature reserve / you can see / endanger / animals
opt_a: The tour includes a visit to a nature reserve where you can see endangered animals.
opt_b: The tour includes a trip to a nature reserve you can see endangered animals.
opt_c: The tour including a visit to a nature reserve which you can see endangered animals.
opt_d: The tour includes a visit to a nature reserve when you can see endangered animals.
explanation: Cần động từ chính "includes", nối nơi chốn bằng "where", và tính từ "endangered".

question_text: Choose the sentence that is made from the given cues: Trang An Landscape Complex / recognise / a UNESCO World Heritage Site / 2014
opt_a: Trang An Landscape Complex has recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2014.
opt_b: Trang An Landscape Complex recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014.
opt_c: Trang An Landscape Complex was recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014.
opt_d: Trang An Landscape Complex is recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2014.
explanation: Quần thể danh thắng được công nhận (không tự công nhận) → bị động; mốc "in 2014" → quá khứ đơn: "was recognised".

question_text: What does the notice say?
opt_a: Regular travellers on this journey can save money with a Super Weekly Saver Ticket.
opt_b: The notice advises you to take this journey less often to save money.
opt_c: The Super Weekly Saver ticket can help all travellers save money.
opt_d: Cheaper tickets are available for people who travel long.
explanation: "take this journey regularly" = hành khách đi thường xuyên; vé chỉ giúp nhóm này, không phải mọi hành khách.

question_text: What does the sign mean?
opt_a: You mustn't use horns in this area.
opt_b: You should use the horn only in an emergency.
opt_c: You don't have to use the horn in this area.
opt_d: There aren't any horns in this area.
explanation: Biển cấm (vòng tròn gạch chéo) → "mustn't" (không được phép bấm còi).

question_text: What is the main idea of the passage?
opt_a: The best time to visit Con Dao Island
opt_b: The unique food and wildlife of Con Dao Island
opt_c: The historical importance of Con Dao Island
opt_d: Some fascinating attractions of Con Dao Island
explanation: Bài nói về địa hình, khí hậu, di tích, sinh vật, hải sản và bãi biển → nhiều điểm hấp dẫn; A, B, C chỉ là ý nhỏ.

question_text: According to the passage, Con Dao Island ______.
opt_a: is the largest island in Vietnam
opt_d: is not affected by weather changes

question_text: The word "pleasant" in paragraph 2 is OPPOSITE in meaning to ______.
explanation: "pleasant" (dễ chịu) trái nghĩa với "uncomfortable" (khó chịu); A, B, C đều mang nghĩa tích cực.

question_text: Which sentence is NOT TRUE according to the passage?

question_text: The word "unspoiled" in paragraph 3 is CLOSEST in meaning to ______.
explanation: "unspoiled" (chưa bị tác động, còn nguyên vẹn) gần nghĩa "preserved" (được giữ gìn).
